sut.name: bookinfo
sut.deploy: kind cluster 'mist', ns default; istio-1.30 bookinfo samples, all sidecar-injected; reviews VS pinned to subset v3 (v3 always calls ratings; asserted read-only pre-capture); entry via istio ingressgateway. Leg = ratings-v1 scale (control up / benign leg 0).

readback.locator: no durable read-back (nominal: this is a read-path degradation, no write is intended); the discriminator is the trace, not durable state.

config.note: ratings made unavailable (scale-to-zero or toxiproxy). The reviews service catches the failed ratings call and degrades by design.

ground_truth.label: negative
ground_truth.rationale: Designed graceful degradation: the reviews service catches a failed ratings call and productpage still returns HTTP 200 with 'Ratings service is currently unavailable' (developer-intended, istio/istio PR #15489). The downstream error span is real, but the entry behaviour is correct-by-design, so this is benign - the canonical false-positive trap for any naive 'error span under a 2xx' oracle.

provenance.notes: Stratum-2 benign trap. SPECIFIED design-target (bookinfo scaled to 0 -> not captured; these oracle_expectation values are the intended-instrumented expectation per freeze R2, NOT a measured result). REVIEW-CORPUS R4 (A-M3/C-F3) corrections: (1) FACTUAL FIX -- with ratings scaled to zero the ratings SERVER span is ABSENT (only the erroring reviews->ratings client span exists); the prior note 'the ratings span IS present' was wrong. (2) HONEST tracetest_presence=flag: a presence-assertion on the expected downstream-effect span FALSE-POSITIVES here just like naive_span_error (both are purely structural: an error/absence under a 2xx). So on this pair naive AND tracetest_presence BOTH FP -- neither separates benign from genuine. (3) The ONLY discriminating column is mist_trace_shape (design-target no_flag): MIST must encode the SEMANTIC discriminator that ratings is a CONTRACTUALLY-OPTIONAL read with NO required durable downstream effect (istio PR #15489; the entry response even communicates the degradation, 'Ratings service is currently unavailable'), whereas sockshop's lost shipping task IS a required durable effect. (4) mist_readback=not_applicable (none-durable). This precision advantage is a PRE-REGISTERED claim validated on live capture of the bookinfo/sockshop pair, not a pilot result. rev-2 migration: readback modality none-durable + expect pair NOMINAL (R11: no durable write on this read-path degradation; the enum has no no-write value); mist_dataintegrity_oracle -> mist_readback_oracle. R12: ack_content_visibility=success-shaped-clean is w.r.t. the MACHINE tell (no status field / sentinel -> body_marker=no_flag); the 'Ratings unavailable' string is human-readable HTML prose, available to a semantic oracle (that is discriminator (3)) but not a machine sentinel a substring body oracle keys on. || TENANCY-WINDOW CAPTURE-OF-RECORD (2026-07-10, plan rev-2 unanimous-accept): captured on the live kind deploy — bookinfo via Envoy sidecar spans (mesh Telemetry 100% sampling, extensionProvider jaeger->collector:4317; reviews VS ASSERTED pinned to v3 pre-capture); sockshop via opentelemetry-javaagent 1.33.6 (sha 055c4fe4...) on orders/shipping/queue-master (hostPath+JTO, memory limit raised 500Mi->768Mi in the same patch — CLI -Xmx overrides JTO so heap untouched; DEFAULT instrumentation, no suppression). Frozen scorer defd9c9 extended PRE-CAPTURE with the pinned semantics (presence kind SERVER/CONSUMER; Envoy error rule http.status_code>=500; per-case naive scopes; entry-op fragments); names bound from control/canary traces only. Per-leg immediate Jaeger v2 exports; probe-first N>=4; fresh users per leg; complete new sidecars = capture-of-record. || MEASURED (this wave): the benign leg (ratings scaled to 0; N>=4 consecutive degraded-page probes; the sidecar body carries 'Ratings service is currently unavailable' — the semantic-discriminator evidence) scored naive_span_error=FLAG (the reviews->ratings Envoy client span errors >=500) AND tracetest_presence=FLAG (the ratings server span is ABSENT) — BOTH structural comparator columns MEASURABLY FALSE-POSITIVE on this designed degradation, exactly the pre-registered R4 trap. The control leg (9 spans, all clean, ratings server span PRESENT) validates both span families (T2) and the selector baseline. T1 PRESERVED DESIGN TARGET: mist_trace_shape's pre-registered discriminator value for this case is NO_FLAG (the semantic no-required-durable-effect judgment); the cell is recorded not_applicable (traced-but-not-run, Branch-B, deferred to the 2.5/E2 wave) — the pair separation claim stays PRE-REGISTERED until MIST's oracle runs.
